_original_lore: The Mochibear Panda is a passive mob that can be found on Galatea.
They only appear while it is Autumn or Winter.
name: 麻薯熊熊猫 (动物)

source: The Mochibear Panda is a passive mob that can be found on Galatea.
loreParagraphs.translation: 麻薯熊熊猫是一种被动生物,可在加拉蒂亚找到.

source: They only appear while it is Autumn or Winter.
loreParagraphs.translation: 它们只在秋季或冬季出现.
